summary: The market enters expiry settlement near the day's midpoint, about half a percent down. It has pared from the lows, but IT and financials keep a lid on any late bounce.

detail.laggards: Bajaj Finance, Infosys, HCLTech (top Sensex losers); Nifty IT at 52-week lows for Infosys, Wipro, KPIT, Tata Elxsi; consumer durables
detail.tone: Steady versus 14:30: at 2:53 pm the Sensex was down 341.19 (−0.47%) at 72,430.50, so the Nifty is near 22,670 and still in the 22,650–22,720 band it has held since noon.
